biggest_catch: The $500 is a BUSINESS checking bonus: you must deposit $5,000 within 30 days and hold a $5,000 minimum daily balance for days 31–90. The consumer checking bonus is only $300.
catches: This is the business checking bonus (Preferred, Interest, or Essential Business Checking); the personal checking bonus is a separate $300 (or $600 with savings).
Use promo code 2034SBCK26 when opening; open with new money not currently held by Hancock Whitney before the 2/28/2027 expiration.
Deposit $5,000 within 30 days of opening and maintain a $5,000 minimum daily balance from days 31 to 90.

Payout within 135 days of opening (the bank also frames it as within 45 days after the 90-day requirements period); account(s) must be open and with a positive balance at payout or the bonus is forfeited.

Available to new-to-bank clients or existing Hancock Whitney checking clients who currently do not have a business or commercial checking account; must not have closed a business or commercial checking account in the past 90 days, or had a checking account closed with a negative balance in the past 3 years.
Preferred Checking ($18/month) and Interest Checking ($25/month) have monthly service charges — waived with $5,000 / $25,000 minimum daily balance respectively or other criteria.

steps: Open a new Hancock Whitney Preferred, Interest, or Essential Business Checking account by 2/28/2027 using promo code 2034SBCK26, funded with new money not currently held by Hancock Whitney.
Make at least $5,000 in qualifying deposits within the first 30 days of opening.
Maintain a minimum daily balance of $5,000 from day 31 through day 90 after opening.
Keep the account open and with a positive balance; the $500 bonus is deposited into your business checking account within 135 days of opening.
timing: Bonus deposited into the new business checking account within 135 days of opening; the bank also states payout within 45 days after the 90-day requirements period. Account must be open with a positive balance at payout.
